name: the chat's reach conditional: access, and the return of decisions to the thread
what_it_changes: P23 (a candidate) says members move planning into a chat and bring its decisions back. In these rooms the chat's reach depends on working access, and those outside it learn only what returns to the thread; its decisions do not bind those who cannot see them.
why: Cut rules R1 and R2 (tree-D4.md), with R1a (the level): the key's lines, read whole in _analysis/d4a02_keys/add-condition_P23_T3-014.txt, state one shared change to P23. R1a: T3-014 holds 25 of the 26 rooms. 'Participation through chat depends on usable invitations and access that several participants report lacking' (placestart); 'Chat coordination must reach placers outside the chat' (masseffect); 'Reported chat decisions cannot be treated as room-wide consensus when nonparticipants and competing factions contest the chat's authority' (fivenightsatfreddys). These are the labelers' how sentences.
